title: Conditions on Which an Air Ticket Fare Brand May Be Sold and Ticketed
content:
One of the seven Air Ticket Fare Brands may only be sold when three things hold together: the booking is opened at least the brand's advance-purchase distance ahead of the outbound departure date, the return falls no earlier than the brand's minimum stay and no later than its maximum stay, and the number of travellers is below the brand's group threshold.

## 1. The hold

An unticketed hold stands for the brand's hold window and is released without charge when it lapses. A brand whose hold window is zero must be ticketed in the same session or not sold at all.

## 2. Collection at ticketing

Ticketing collects the fare, the taxes and carrier fees, and the agency service fee together; a partly collected booking is never ticketed.

Where the traveller qualifies for an instalment plan under the brand held and the booking value reaches the brand's instalment threshold, the fare may be collected in instalments, and the ticket is issued on the first instalment.

## 3. Groups

A group of travellers at or above the brand's group threshold is not ticketed under these conditions at all and is passed to the group desk.

## 4. The three conditions of sale, as a table

| Condition | What must hold | Measured against |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Advance purchase | the booking is opened at least this far ahead of the outbound departure date | the brand's advance-purchase distance in calendar days |
| Stay | the return falls no earlier than the minimum stay and no later than the maximum stay | the brand's minimum stay in nights and maximum stay in calendar days |
| Party size | the number of travellers is below the threshold | the brand's group threshold |

All three must hold. A booking that satisfies two of them and fails the third is not a sale under that brand.

## 5. Hypothetical boundary readings

A brand whose advance-purchase distance is 7 days is open to a booking opened exactly 7 days ahead of departure, since the condition is "at least" that distance, and closed to one opened 6 days ahead.

A brand whose group threshold is 9 travellers admits a booking for 8 travellers, because 8 is below 9; a booking for 9 travellers is at the threshold and is passed to the group desk rather than ticketed here.

A brand whose hold window is 0 hours cannot carry a hold at all: there is no period during which an unticketed booking may stand, so the booking is ticketed in the same session or the brand is not sold.

## 6. Point of judgement

**Where a booking qualifies for instalments, what is collected before the ticket is issued?** The first instalment. The rule that a partly collected booking is never ticketed and the instalment clause stand together: the instalment plan changes what full collection means for that booking, and the ticket issues on the first instalment.
